Nested properties (direct types, within maps, collections) are introspected for nested projections and contain
property paths for closed projections.
items.translation: 嵌套属性（直接类型、映射和集合中的内部类型）会进行内省以支持嵌套投影，并包含用于封闭投影的属性路径。

items.source:
This class introspects the returned type in the context of a domain type for all reachable properties (w/o cycles) to
determine which property paths are subject to projection.
items.translation: 该类会在域类型的上下文中，对所有可达属性（无循环）进行内省，以确定哪些属性路径适用于投影。
